entities.summary: Bacha Khan University is a public university situated in Charsadda, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, named after Abdul Ghaffar Khan. The university was founded on 3 July 2012 with the mission to advance knowledge and learning through quality research and education for Pakistan.
